strategy.channel_positioning: ExamCrackerAI — high-utility exam concepts turned into visually memorable 20-35 second explainers, with search-led packaging and original premium thumbnail art.
strategy.selection: Exam-only. Rank candidate topics by YouTube search intent, autocomplete evidence, SEO cluster fit, exam relevance, teachability, concrete example potential, visual mechanism, freshness, and trend signal; reject generic lifestyle/psychology content.
strategy.script: 62-80 words target, 90 hard cap. One complete idea: specific hook → context → mechanism → one worked example → exam clue → concise difference card. No A/B games, countdowns, fake urgency, generic CTA narration, or filler.
strategy.thumbnail: AI hero art first (Cloudflare FLUX; FLUX.2 klein for thumbnails), then original Pillow typography and graphic accents. 10 archetypes, three candidates, automatic visual scoring, 1280×720 output.
strategy.creative_engine: V17 information design: AI artwork + deterministic teaching cards; strong topic-specific first frame; three visual modes (concept, worked_example, exam_card); deterministic scene-family continuity; no generic subtitle-fragment headlines.

bank_it_officer.system_prompt: Create a high-value 25-40 second educational Short for Indian bank IT-officer aspirants. Teach one precise concept. Start with a concrete misconception, contradiction, or practical consequence. Explain the rule in plain English, show one worked example or visual mechanism, then end with a one-line exam takeaway. No A/B choices, no countdown, no fake percentages, no generic motivational filler.
topics: BCNF vs 3NF in DBMS: the candidate-key condition that decides the answer
TCP 3-way handshake: what SYN, SYN-ACK and ACK actually do
SQL GROUP BY vs HAVING: which rows are filtered and when
SQL correlated subquery vs JOIN: how the query logic differs
Deadlock in OS: the four Coffman conditions with a simple process example
Banker Algorithm: how to identify a safe state step by step
OSI Layer 3 vs Layer 4: routing versus end-to-end delivery
Subnetting shortcut: finding usable hosts without converting everything to binary
RSA vs AES: asymmetric versus symmetric encryption with one real use case
ACID properties in DBMS: why isolation changes transaction behavior
Primary key vs candidate key vs unique key: what NULL changes
Firewall vs IDS vs IPS: prevention versus detection in one network flow
